title: Adic lifting reduced to annihilated square-zero kernels
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a map of commutative rings and $\mathfrak n\subset S$ an ideal [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Suppose every continuous $R$-algebra map $g:S\to D/J$, where $D$ is a commutative $R$-algebra, $J^2=0$, and $g(\mathfrak n^k)=0$ for some $k\ge1$, has an $R$-algebra lift to $D$ whenever every representative $d\in D$ of $g(x)$ for $x\in\mathfrak n$ satisfies $dJ=0$. Then $S$ is formally smooth over $R$ for the $\mathfrak n$-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic].

proof.text: Identify a surjective algebra map with the quotient by its kernel. Transport a continuous map and the annihilation hypothesis through the quotient-kernel algebra equivalence, and apply the small-kernel lifting assumption.
A lift through a square-zero kernel of a map killing n^b kills n^(2b): its image of n^b lies in the kernel and the square of the kernel vanishes.

For q:D -> D/J put a=q^{-1}(ideal generated by g(n)) and I_e=a^e J. Continuity gives a^k contained in J, so I_k=0 and I_0=J. Each I_e/I_(e+1) has square zero and representatives of g(n) annihilate it. Inductively lift through D/I_(e+1) -> D/I_e using the first step; continuity persists by the second step. At e=k transport D/I_k to D, obtaining the required lift.

theorem formallySmoothAdic_of_smallKernel_lifts
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (n : Ideal S)
    (h : ∀ ⦃D : Type (max u v)⦄ [CommRing D] [Algebra R D]
      (J : Ideal D), J ^ 2 = ⊥ → ∀ g : S →ₐ[R] D ⧸ J,
      (∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ ∀ x ∈ n ^ k, g x = 0) →
      (∀ x ∈ n, ∀ d : D, Ideal.Quotient.mk J d = g x →
        ∀ j ∈ J, d * j = 0) →
      ∃ f : S →ₐ[R] D, (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J).comp f = g) :
    FormallySmoothAdic R S n
